rca.title: Race condition in session cache
rca.description: Simultaneous token refresh corrupts memory cache entries.
rca.root_cause: The global cache object is accessed and modified concurrently by multiple async operations without proper synchronization, leading to a race condition.
rca.suggested_fix: Implement locking or use a concurrent-safe data structure to manage cache updates.
rca.mechanism: Race condition due to unsynchronized access to shared resource

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Race condition due to unsynchronized access to shared resource
supporting_evidence: src/cache/session.ts:4 - 'cache[id] = val;' is a write operation on a shared resource without any locking mechanism.
src/cache/session.ts:2 - 'async function refresh(id)' indicates concurrent execution.

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Logical error in token assignment logic
supporting_evidence: src/cache/session.ts:4 - 'cache[id] = val;' could potentially be incorrect if 'val' is not properly validated.
contradicting_evidence: The primary issue is identified as a race condition, not a logical error, and the problem description focuses on concurrency issues.
